error.Size: Field {{ fieldName }} does not meet min/max size requirements!
error.idexists: A new {{ entityName }} cannot already have an ID
error.accountidblank: The vendor search was sent with an empty portal login, which would match every vendor rather than one. Type the login you are looking for, or clear the box to list them all.
error.accountidexists: Another vendor already holds that portal login, and a login can only identify one vendor. Give this vendor a login of its own, or clear it from the vendor that no longer uses it.
error.blankfilter: One of the directory filters was sent with nothing in it. Choose a value for that filter, or remove it and list everything.
error.codeexists: Another service plan already carries that code. A code names one plan across the platform, so give this plan a different one.
error.cyclicancestor: A place cannot sit inside itself. Choose a parent that is neither this place nor one of the places already beneath it.
error.cyclicancestry: The places above the parent you chose already lead back round to it, so nothing can be filed under it until that is untangled. Choose a different parent, and have the chain above it corrected.
error.cyclicparent: A place cannot be its own parent. Choose a different parent, or leave the parent empty to make this a top-level place.
error.linknotfound: That directory entry is no longer there — it may have been reconciled or removed while this page was open. Refresh the list and try again.
error.localidintoolong: Too many records were asked about at once. Narrow the filter, or work through the list a page at a time.
error.nosubjectkey: That directory entry carries no email address, so there is nobody to send the decision to. It cannot be verified until the record it came from supplies one.
error.notapatientlink: That directory entry does not belong to a patient, and only a patient's plan choice can be verified. Open the record from the patient directory and try again.
error.notiernamed: That plan choice names no tier, so there is nothing to verify yet. The patient has to choose a plan before it can be approved.
error.professionalnotfound: No professional answers to that record. Choose the professional from the directory rather than entering a record id by hand.
error.torequired: A message needs somebody to go to. Name the recipient before sending it.

file.not.image: File was expected to be an image but was found to be "{{ fileType }}"
